2. If I were to propose to another school first, such as y, I might face competition because most applicants prefer y > x > w > z. Even though I also have a high priority at y (rank 1), the competition could be stiff, and I might not be accepted if another applicant with the same priority rank also proposes there. 

3. Schools x and z are less preferred, and my priority rank is lower compared to w. Proposing to them first might result in a less optimal match, especially since I have a guaranteed spot at w.

Therefore, my strategy is to propose to school w first, where I have the highest priority and my most preferred choice, ensuring the best possible outcome.
